Sam: quick ask — can someone swap with me for tonight (7pm-11pm)? I have a customer call that ran long.
Maya: I can take it, Sam. Please drop the open incidents and any hot handoff notes here.
Sam: thanks! short rundown: Inc-231 DB timeouts (intermittent 504s, started ~16:40 UTC), Inc-244 model-serving 95th-latency spike after the 4pm rollout, Inc-250 billing alert showing quota mismatch for customer acct-92. None are fully paged yet but all on watch.
Jonathan: noted. I can be the infra escalation between 8-10 if anything looks like disk/IO or network. Ping me with :rotating_light: if DB errors > 20%.
Lee: saw some search-index lag in telemetry earlier, might be related to the model-serving spike. Add to triage agenda?
Maya: yes please add. I'll host the triage call — joining 7:05 to do handoff 7:10. Zoom: `https://zoom.redwood/triage` (will post bridge link in calendar).
Sam: handoff notes (brief):
```
- last deploy sha: d9f8a3c
- primary DB write node: db-write-02 (watch CPU)
- recent config change: query-timeout from 30s -> 20s (applied 15:00)
- quick mitigations tried: restarted model-serving pods in canary, rolled back no-op change to config route.
```
Maya: copying notes to runbook now. Who's on escalation for DB if Inc-231 worsens?
Anita: I can be escalation for DB after 7:30 if needed. Will keep pager on. :thumbsup:
opsbot: oncall-swap recorded — owner changed: Sam -> Maya (2026-03-17T19:00:00Z).
Lee: agenda suggestion for the 7:10 triage (short):
- 7:05 rollcall + quick context
- 7:10 Sam -> Maya handoff (what changed / known mitigations)
- 7:20 incident prioritization (Inc-231 / Inc-244 / Inc-250)
- 7:30 assign owners & escalation contacts
- 7:40 check split for any long-running tasks + follow-ups
Maya: perfect. I'll also add a check: if Inc-231 error rate > 20% for 5m, trigger DB paging and open bridge. If model 95th > 1.5s, fallback to model-v1 (auto-rollback policy).
Sam: thanks all. I put a small TODO in the incident channel: update runbook with `db-write-02` notes, link traces. Leaving logs pointer here: `s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1812345678/`
Jonathan: calendar updated — I blocked 8-10 for infra escalation just in case.
Maya: awesome. I'll post the triage minutes after the call and ping the postmortem owner if we need one.
Anita: will join if DB pages, otherwise monitoring from standby.
Sam: appreciate it, see you all later.
Maya: thanks — starting the call 7:05, invite sent. :white_check_mark:
